items.guidance: Port 8000 is the detected application port; confirm it is the default of the API server that the docker/Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT starts and that no --port argument overrides it. If the server takes its port from a command-line option, not PORT, add only EXPOSE 8000 and report the option name.

Check the routes of the API server started by the image entrypoint for an existing health or ping route that answers without an API key. If one exists, report its path and add nothing. If an API key option protects all routes, confirm whether that route is exempt and report the result.

Check docker/Dockerfile and the docker directory for a CPU target or a separate CPU Dockerfile, and check for a device setting in the server options. Report the file or setting and its CPU value, and whether the expected models are practical on CPU only.
